svg.title: goPool benchmark heat map
svg.desc: Heat map of all numeric values in the mining.submit and mining.notify benchmark tables. Each metric column is colored independently; green is better and red is worse.
svg.text: Every numeric table value is a tile. Each metric column is scaled independently: green is better, red is worse.

g.text: Rows are pool/miner-count runs. Latency is ms.
